_description: Policy for npm audit JSON results. High and critical vulnerabilities fail CI unless they are documented in the accepted array with reason, expiry and follow-up.

_acceptedRiskTemplate.reason: Explain why the risk is temporarily accepted. Include exposure, current project status and why the fix is deferred.

accepted.reason: Temporary acceptance for a transitive build-time dependency. This project does not process user-supplied CSS or source-map files; a compatible lockfile update is tracked separately.
Temporary acceptance while the compatible remediation path is verified. The application is a client-rendered Vite SPA and does not use React Server Components or React Router RSC mode.
Temporary acceptance of the inherited React Router finding while the compatible remediation path is verified. The application does not use React Router RSC mode.
Temporary acceptance for a development-only ESLint configuration dependency. It is not bundled into the application runtime; remediation requires the tracked ESLint major-version upgrade.
Temporary acceptance for a development-only legacy ESLint configuration dependency. It is not part of the production runtime; remediation is tied to the tracked ESLint major-version upgrade.
Temporary acceptance for a Storybook documentation build dependency. It is used only during local component documentation builds and is not shipped with the application runtime.

Temporary acceptance for the development-only Storybook toolchain. The vulnerable path is not included in the production application bundle; the compatible Storybook major upgrade is tracked separately.
Temporary acceptance for a transitive development-tool dependency used by linting and documentation tooling. Untrusted glob patterns are not accepted from application users.
Temporary acceptance for the development-only linting toolchain. ESLint is not present in the production runtime, and the available remediation requires a separately verified semver-major upgrade.
Temporary acceptance for a transitive ESLint cache dependency used only during development and CI. It is not included in the deployed application runtime.
Temporary acceptance for a transitive ESLint cache dependency used only during development and CI. It is not included in the deployed application runtime.
Temporary acceptance for a transitive development-tool dependency used by Storybook and linting. The application does not expose arbitrary glob processing to users.
Temporary acceptance for a transitive development-tool dependency used by linting and Storybook. The application does not evaluate user-controlled glob patterns at runtime.
Temporary acceptance for a transitive development-only cleanup dependency. It is not used in the application runtime and remediation follows the tracked toolchain upgrades.
